item.title: Continued Crypto Fund Outflows Slows Bitcoin Recovery
item.description: IG analyst Chris Beauchamp has analyzed the current state of Bitcoin and the crypto market, providing the catalysts for the next price trajectory. In a note today, Beauchamp highlighted that the current market is struggling to recover following a disastrous end to the previous year.Visit Website

item.title: Standard Chartered: Ethereum Could Hit $7,500 This Year and Outpace Bitcoin
item.description: Ethereum is increasingly being viewed as the stronger long-term performer compared to Bitcoin, according to a new outlook from Standard Chartered. The bank believes Ethereum’s fundamentals have improved enough to support the sustained outperformance of Bitcoin.Visit Website

item.title: Data Shows the Latest Bitcoin Rebound May Not Be Sustainable
item.description: The latest Bitcoin rebound push, which began earlier in the year, may be unsustainable due to the absence of retail demand. IT Tech, a pseudonymous CryptoQuant author, revealed this in one of his latest market commentaries.Visit Website

item.title: XRP ETFs Have Now Recovered the $40M Outflow Recorded Earlier This Year
item.description: The XRP ETFs have now officially recovered the $40 million worth of capital outflow they recorded earlier this year. This comes on the back of the latest inflow data, as the products attracted $12.98 million worth of capital influx on Jan.Visit Website

item.title: Bitcoin Breakout Above $96,000 Drives $678M in Market Liquidations
item.description: Bitcoin surged on Tuesday, briefly reaching a two-month high as traders unwound bearish positions and rotated capital into other cryptocurrencies. The rally gained momentum after Bitcoin pushed through the $95,000 resistance, a price that had capped multiple rallies in recent months.Visit Website

item.title: A Sustained Shiba Inu Breakout Hinges on a Positive Crypto Market
item.description: SHIB KNIGHT, a long-standing crypto investor, highlighted a breakout for Shiba Inu but suggested it would need a positive crypto market to sustain. The analyst raised this sentiment in a recent tweet.Visit Website

item.title: Clarity Act Now Puts XRP on Equal Legal Footing With Bitcoin and Ethereum
item.description: Crypto journalist Eleanor Terrett has pointed out a key provision in the draft of the U.S. Digital Asset Market Clarity Act that could place XRP in the same category as Bitcoin and Ethereum.Visit Website

item.title: SEC Approves Bitwise Chainlink Spot ETF to Trade on NYSE
item.description: Bitwise has secured regulatory approval to launch a Chainlink exchange-traded fund (ETF) in the United States. The move marks another milestone in the expansion of regulated crypto investment products.Visit Website

item.title: Solana Price Prediction for Jan 14: SOL Must Break This Bollinger Band Resistance
item.description: The Solana price faces critical resistance at the upper Bollinger Band, with a breakout needed for continued bullish momentum or risk consolidation. item.title: Germany’s DZ Bank Secures MiCAR License for Retail Crypto Platform
item.description: Germany’s cooperative banking sector is taking a decisive step toward regulated crypto adoption after DZ Bank secured authorization under the EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCAR). The approval clears the way for the rollout of meinKrypto, a trading platform enabling retail customers to access digital assets through their local cooperative banks under a regulated framework.Visit Website
